A type of '''shopkeeper droid''' was used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It resembled a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]], but with a flat-topped head.
